description: Skills Discovery + Skills Catalog + Semantic Memory (Features 15-16 from the import plan). Implements local skill scanning with frontmatter parsing, remote catalog fetching/caching, and the semantic memory manager wrapping embedding-based retrieval.
steps: Create src/nexus/tools/skills_discovery.py with: LocalSkill dataclass (id, name, description, provider, scope, path); parse_skill_frontmatter(md) function extracting name+description from YAML frontmatter in SKILL.md (handle block scalar descriptions with | or > indicators); scan_skill_dir(dir, provider, scope) function walking a directory for folders containing SKILL.md; list_local_skills(cwds, bundled_dir) function scanning Claude skills dirs (~/.claude/skills/ + project .claude/skills/), OpenCode plugin dirs (~/.config/opencode/plugin/), Codex plugin dirs (~/.codex/plugins/); deduplicates by provider+name with scope precedence: project > user > bundled. Port logic from munder-difflin/src/main/skills.ts.

Create src/nexus/tools/skills_catalog.py with: CatalogSkill dataclass (name, description, url, category, owner); parse_catalog_markdown(md) function parsing GitHub README tables into entries (handles ## Category headings, | Name | Description | Link | table rows, extracts GitHub owner from URL); load_catalog(cache_path, force=False) async function fetching from URL with disk cache (24h TTL), stale-on-failure fallback. Port parsing logic from parseCatalogMarkdown in munder-difflin/src/main/skills.ts.

Create src/nexus/memory/semantic.py with: EmbeddingModel(str, Enum) with values 'minilm', 'embeddinggemma'; SemanticMemoryManager class wrapping embedding-based retrieval backend. Methods: mine_agent(agent_dir, agent_id) indexes an agent's memory into per-agent namespace (subprocess call to mempalace mine), search(query, wing=None, results=5) does meaning-based recall, status() reports availability (checks shutil.which for mempalace binary). Degrades silently to no-op when embedding backend unavailable. Periodic mining with mtime-based skip for unchanged files (lastMined dict tracking mtime). Port from munder-difflin/src/main/memory.ts.

Create tests/test_skills_discovery.py with tests for: parse_skill_frontmatter with inline and block scalar descriptions, scan_skill_dir with mock directories (tmp_path fixture), list_local_skills deduplication by scope precedence, handling of missing/unreadable directories

Create tests/test_skills_catalog.py with tests for: parse_catalog_markdown correctly parsing table rows with categories, handling malformed rows, extracting GitHub owner, load_catalog with cache hit (fresh), cache miss (network fetch mock), stale-on-failure fallback

Create tests/test_semantic_memory.py with tests for: SemanticMemoryManager.status() when mempalace not available (shutil.which returns None), mine_agent with mock subprocess, search with mock subprocess, mtime-based skip logic (unchanged files not re-mined), silent degradation when backend unavailable
acceptance_criteria: parse_skill_frontmatter correctly extracts name and description from YAML frontmatter including block scalars
scan_skill_dir finds folders containing SKILL.md and parses them into LocalSkill entries
list_local_skills deduplicates with scope precedence (project > user > bundled)
parse_catalog_markdown parses table rows under category headings into CatalogSkill entries
load_catalog uses disk cache with 24h TTL and falls back to stale cache on failure
SemanticMemoryManager degrades to no-op when mempalace CLI not available
mine_agent uses mtime-based skip for unchanged memory files
search delegates to subprocess and returns output
All new tests pass with python3.12 -m pytest
Full test suite (1651+ tests) still passes
verification: python3.12 -m pytest tests/ -x -q (full suite still passes)
